facts.text: John mentioned that the motivated people around him gave him renewed energy and a purpose, inspiring him to make a bigger difference.

evidence.quote: The motivated people around me gave me renewed energy and a purpose. It really inspired me to make a bigger difference.
The best part was the energy in the room - so infectious! We all had great ideas, brainstormed together, and stayed motivated.

facts.text: John is planning a trip to the East Coast.

evidence.quote: I'm planning a trip to the East Coast. How about you? Anything cool going on recently?
